description: Single source of truth defining canonical features, data types, physical units, validation bounds, and availability statuses for the future real-time road risk classification model.

target_definition.description: Multi-class road safety condition independently observed or derived from multi-factor disaster impedance.

features.name: rainfall_mm_h
features.source: OpenWeatherMap API / Open-Meteo API (/api/weather) or manual telemetry
features.description: Current instant precipitation intensity in millimeters per hour.

features.name: rainfall_10min_mm
features.source: Derived rolling telemetry window from weather station API
features.description: Accumulated rainfall depth over the preceding 10-minute window, capturing sudden flash downpours.

features.name: rainfall_1h_mm
features.source: OpenWeatherMap API 'rain.1h' telemetry
features.description: Accumulated rainfall depth over the preceding 1-hour window, indicating saturation.

features.name: visibility_m
features.source: OpenWeatherMap API 'visibility' field
features.description: Horizontal atmospheric visibility distance in meters, constrained by fog, heavy downpour, or smoke.

features.name: temperature_c
features.source: OpenWeatherMap API / Open-Meteo API 'main.temp'
features.description: Ambient air temperature in degrees Celsius.

features.name: wind_speed_kmh
features.source: OpenWeatherMap API / Open-Meteo API 'wind.speed' converted to km/h
features.description: Instantaneous wind speed in kilometers per hour.

features.name: traffic_level
features.source: Traffic estimation feed or driver dashboard input
features.description: Normalized traffic intensity index from 1 (completely free flow) to 10 (gridlock / grid standstill).

features.name: vehicle_density
features.source: Traffic API / highway CCTV / road segment telemetry
features.description: Estimated count of vehicles per kilometer per lane.

features.name: congestion_change
features.source: Temporal difference of traffic_level over 15-minute rolling window
features.description: Rate of change of traffic congestion (+ indicates rapidly building backup, - indicates clearing).

features.name: vehicle_speed_kmh
features.source: Vehicle GPS speed / OBD-II / smartphone speedometer
features.description: Current ground speed of the host vehicle in kilometers per hour.

features.name: acceleration_mps2
features.source: Vehicle inertial measurement unit (IMU) / smartphone accelerometer
features.description: Longitudinal acceleration (+ accelerating, - deceleration/braking) in meters per second squared.

features.name: braking_intensity
features.source: CAN-bus brake pedal sensor / deceleration threshold classifier
features.description: Normalized braking effort where 0.0 is coasting/no brake and 1.0 is emergency full lock/ABS engagement.

features.name: road_slope_pct
features.source: Digital Elevation Model (DEM) / OpenStreetMap slope / vehicle pitch gyro
features.description: Road gradient percentage (+ uphill, - downhill). Steeper negative slopes exacerbate flood pooling.

features.name: elevation_m
features.source: GPS altitude / Open-Elevation API
features.description: Terrain altitude above mean sea level in meters; lower basins correlate with inundation risk.

features.name: road_type
features.source: OpenStreetMap road highway tag mapping
features.description: Categorical road classification: 0: Urban Street, 1: Highway/Expressway, 2: Rural/Unpaved, 3: Bridge, 4: Underpass/Tunnel.

features.name: vehicle_count
features.source: YOLOv11 Master Model detection count for class 'Vehicle' (ID 4)
features.description: Number of vehicles detected in the camera / dashcam field of view.

features.name: person_count
features.source: YOLOv11 Master Model detection count for class 'Person' (ID 3)
features.description: Number of pedestrians / stranded victims detected in the camera view.

features.name: fire_detected
features.source: YOLOv11 Master Model presence flag for class 'Fire' (ID 1)
features.description: Binary flag indicating whether active flame or wildfire was visually identified.

features.name: smoke_detected
features.source: YOLOv11 Master Model presence flag for class 'Smoke' (ID 2)
features.description: Binary flag indicating whether smoke plume or haze obscuration was visually identified.

features.name: flood_detected
features.source: YOLOv11 Master Model presence flag for class 'Flood' (ID 0)
features.description: Binary flag indicating whether surface water accumulation or road inundation was visually identified.

features.name: obstacle_count
features.source: YOLOv11 Master Model detection count for class 'Road Damage' (ID 5) / debris
features.description: Count of physical road obstacles, potholes, barricades, or debris.

features.name: hazard_count
features.source: Sum of all active hazard bounding boxes output by YOLOv11
features.description: Total count of hazard instances identified in the current camera frame.

features.name: hazard_distance_m
features.source: Monocular camera depth estimation / bounding box geometry / radar telemetry
features.description: Estimated line-of-sight distance in meters to the nearest visual hazard.

features.name: flood_report
features.source: Active hazard reports in MongoDB hazard collection within 2 km radius
features.description: Binary flag indicating whether an active confirmed flood report exists for this road segment.

features.name: road_closure_report
features.source: Disaster management authority closure notice in MongoDB / admin dispatch
features.description: Binary flag indicating whether the highway department has officially closed this road.
